title: Settings — Parts and See Financial Data open every pricing page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data' but not any customer permission. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Type a name no other tier uses.
  4. Click Create Tier.
  5. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  6. Open the new tier's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  7. Click Archive.
  8. Click Archive in the dialog.
  9. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  10. Click the General Matrix's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows with New Tier.

Step 2:

  • The New Tier page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • The tier is created and its page opens.

Step 5:

  • The Tiers list shows the new tier.

Step 6:

  • The menu offers Archive and Delete.

Step 7:

  • The Archive question opens.

Step 8:

  • The tier is archived.

Step 9:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 10:

  • The General Matrix's page opens with its grid and the Price Part Simulator.
